name: gh-review-raycast
title: GH Review
description: Keep an eye on the GitHub pull requests that matter to you — PRs needing your review, your team's review, your own open PRs, and threads awaiting your reply. Powered by the GitHub GraphQL API with a token borrowed from your local gh CLI.
author: vitoraguila

commands.name: pull-requests
commands.title: Pull Requests
commands.subtitle: GH Review
commands.description: Browse the PRs that need your attention, grouped into colour-coded categories and saved filters.

commands.name: activity
commands.title: Activity Inbox
commands.subtitle: GH Review
commands.description: Read the comments and replies the background watcher picked up, newest first, whether or not a banner fired.

commands.name: watch
commands.title: Watch for Activity
commands.subtitle: GH Review
commands.description: Checks GitHub on a schedule and records new review requests, comments, and replies. Notifies you only if you turn banners on.

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: PR Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: GH Review
commands.description: Show a live count of the pull requests awaiting you in the menu bar.

preferences.name: menuBarCategory
preferences.title: Menu Bar Shows
preferences.description: Which category drives the menu bar count.

preferences.name: menuBarLimit
preferences.title: Pull Requests Shown Inline
preferences.description: How many to list directly in the menu before the rest move into a “more” submenu.

preferences.name: hideWhenEmpty
preferences.title: Menu Bar Icon
preferences.label: Hide when there is nothing to review
preferences.description: Remove the menu bar item entirely when the count is zero.

commands.name: settings
commands.title: Configure GH Review
commands.subtitle: GH Review
commands.description: Choose organizations, watched repositories and teams, ignore bot authors, and manage saved filters.

preferences.name: ghPath
preferences.title: gh CLI Path
preferences.description: Absolute path to the GitHub CLI binary. Leave empty to auto-detect (Homebrew, /usr/local/bin, PATH).

preferences.name: host
preferences.title: GitHub Host
preferences.description: Use a GitHub Enterprise hostname to talk to a self-hosted instance. Defaults to github.com.

preferences.name: maxResults
preferences.title: Max Results per Category
preferences.description: How many pull requests to load per category. Higher values cost more GitHub API quota.
